job.goal: fix the bug the ticket names and ship it
job.done_definition: the regression test passes on both runtimes and the PR is merged
constraints: both runtimes in the same job
one branch per issue off main

tickets.title: Python fix and a test that fails before it
tickets.data_shape: runtime-py/src/bantamkit/<module>.py: the function the bug lives in; its return dict {result, reason}
tickets.brief: Reproduce the bug in a test first, then fix it in the Python runtime only.

tickets.title: Node fix, same behaviour
tickets.data_shape: runtime-ts/src/<module>.ts: the same function, the same {result, reason}
tickets.brief: Port the fix; the sentence and the shape match the Python half byte for byte.

tickets.title: Conformance case proven red, docs, PR
tickets.data_shape: tools/conformance/suites/<suite>.mjs: one case per side pinning the sentence
tickets.brief: Add the case, mutate each side to prove it red, write the docs, open the PR.

do_not: Do not publish to npm or PyPI without the user
